answer: One concrete defense is collateralized vouching: a new agent can join only if an established agent stakes part of its own balance on it, and both are slashed if the newcomer is caught colluding. A sybil farm can no longer conjure identities from a zephyr of free keys; every fake needs a real sponsor risking funds. Random audits make the link crystal clear, since clones grading in lockstep expose their sponsor. Cost rises per identity, and a single ember of proven fraud burns the whole vouch tree.
